units.title: 常用表达 · Unit 1

words.english: It was great! I climbed the Great Wall.
I visited the "Gingerbread House" last Saturday.
words.meaning: 我上个星期六去参观“姜饼屋”了。

words.english: Where did you go over the summer holidays, Binbin?
I went to Xi'an with my family.

words.meaning: 你们在那儿做了些什么？

words.english: We went to see the Terracotta Warriors.

units.book: 六年级英语上册 · PEP新版（E63 002015）
units.title: 常用表达 · Unit 2

words.english: How was your Mid-Autumn Festival holiday, Binbin?
words.meaning: 你中秋假期过得怎么样，斌斌？

words.english: My mother and I went to a marathon on Sunday.
words.meaning: 我和妈妈上周日去看了一场马拉松比赛。

words.english: What did you like about it?
What did you do last weekend?

units.book: 六年级英语上册 · PEP新版（E63 002015）
units.title: 常用表达 · Unit 3

words.english: I feel ill. My head hurts and I have a runny nose.
words.meaning: 我感觉不舒服。我头痛还流鼻涕。

words.english: I'm sorry to hear that. Maybe you should see a doctor.
words.meaning: 对此我感到难过。也许你应该去看医生。

words.english: How can we live a healthy life?
words.meaning: 我们怎样能过健康的生活？

words.english: We need to eat healthy food. We should exercise too.
words.meaning: 我们需要吃健康的食物。我们还需要运动。

units.book: 六年级英语上册 · PEP新版（E63 002015）
units.title: 常用表达 · Unit 4

words.english: How are you going to spend it?
I'm going to buy a schoolbag.
I also want to buy some animal books.
words.meaning: 我还想买一些动物类书籍。

words.english: What else are you going to buy?
I'm going to buy a pair of sunglasses for Grandpa.
words.meaning: 我打算给爷爷买一副太阳镜。

words.english: I also want to buy a microscope.

units.book: 六年级英语上册 · PEP新版（E63 002015）
units.title: 常用表达 · Unit 5

words.english: What can you see in the sky?
words.meaning: 你能在天空中看到什么？

words.english: We can see the Sun and clouds.
At night, we can see the Moon and the stars.
words.meaning: 在晚上，我们能看到月亮和星星。

words.english: Is there any water on Mars?
Yes, there is. There is soil too.
I don't think so. They say there aren't any living things.
words.meaning: 我不这样认为。据说那里没有生物。

words.english: China put a rover on Mars.
words.meaning: 中国在火星上放置了探测器。

words.english: The taikonauts get up early in the morning.
words.meaning: 中国航天员很早就起床。

units.book: 六年级英语上册 · PEP新版（E63 002015）
units.title: 常用表达 · Unit 6

words.english: What do you know about it?
What else do you want to know about water?
words.meaning: 关于水你还想了解些什么？

words.english: Wind power, solar power and water power are types of green energy.
words.meaning: 风能、太阳能和水能是不同类型的绿色能源。

words.english: But many resources are running out.
words.meaning: 但是很多资源快要耗尽了。
我们怎样才能节约能源？

words.english: We can also use LED lighting.
We should use air conditioners less.
